<!-- Shared by browse.qmd and en/browse.qmd. Expects OJS variables `lang`, `root`. -->
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { strings } from "/assets/strings.js"
import { link, fmt, toCSV, toBibTeX, toRIS, downloadButton } from "/assets/catalog.js"
t = strings[lang]
catalog = d3.json(root + "data/catalog.json")
htl.html`<p>${t.browseIntro}</p>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof rows = Inputs.search(catalog, { placeholder: t.filterTable, width: "100%",
                                       format: n => fmt(t.showing, { n, total: catalog.length }) })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
stamp = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)
htl.html`<div class="export-bar">
  ${downloadButton("CSV", `acg-catalog-${stamp}.csv`, "text/csv;charset=utf-8", () => toCSV(rows))}
  ${downloadButton("BibTeX", `acg-catalog-${stamp}.bib`, "application/x-bibtex;charset=utf-8", () => toBibTeX(rows))}
  ${downloadButton("RIS", `acg-catalog-${stamp}.ris`, "application/x-research-info-systems;charset=utf-8", () => toRIS(rows))}
</div>`
```

::: {.browse-table}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(rows, {
  columns: ["title", "creators", "year", "publisher", "taxa", "sectors", "category"],
  header: { title: t.title, creators: t.creators, year: t.year, publisher: t.publisher,
            taxa: t.taxa, sectors: t.sectors, category: t.category },
  format: {
    title: (x, i, data) => htl.html`<a href="${link(data[i])}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${x}</a>`,
    year: x => x ?? "",
    category: x => t[x] || x
  },
  layout: "fixed",
  rows: 25,
  height: 640,
  sort: "year",
  reverse: true
})
```
:::
